info.name: Fly Cham CMS API
info.description:
REST API of the Fly Cham CMS backend (`cms/`, TanStack Start on the VPS) — pages & blocks, site header/footer, offers, POS list, excess-baggage prices, destination categories.

Base URL (live): https://cms-api.cms-flycham.alpatrose.com — local dev: http://localhost:3000 (change `baseUrl`).

**Auth:** reads are public. Writes need `Authorization: Bearer <Supabase access token>` of a CMS admin — run *0. Auth → Sign in* first (fill `supabaseKey`, `adminEmail`, `adminPassword`).

**Errors** always look like `{ "error": { "message": "…", "code": "…" } }` (+ `issues[]` for validation errors).

Full reference: `FlyCham-CMS-API-Documentation.md` (same folder).

variable.description: Supabase project used by the CMS (for sign-in only)
Supabase publishable (anon) key — SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY in cms/.env
Set by Sign in / Refresh token
Set by Sign in / Refresh token
Page slug used by page/component requests (test-page is safe to edit)
Component id — set by Get page / Create component
Offer id — set by List offers / Create offer
POS row id — set by Create POS
Destination category id — set by Create category

item.name: 0. Auth (Supabase)
item.description:
Every WRITE endpoint needs `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` of a CMS **admin** user.

The token comes from Supabase Auth (the same project the CMS backend uses). Run **Sign in** once — its test script saves `accessToken` and `refreshToken` into the collection variables, and every write request in this collection already uses `Bearer {{accessToken}}`.

Access tokens expire after ~1 hour → run **Refresh token** (or Sign in again).

Fill the collection variables `supabaseKey` (the project's *publishable/anon* key — `SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` in `cms/.env`), `adminEmail` and `adminPassword` first.

query.description: Password grant

request.description:
Supabase Auth password sign-in. Returns `access_token` (JWT, ~1h), `refresh_token`, `expires_in`, `user`.

The test script stores `accessToken` / `refreshToken` in the collection variables.

query.description: Refresh grant

request.description: Exchange the saved refresh token for a new access token (refresh tokens are single-use; the new one is saved too).

item.name: Am I a CMS admin? (rpc is_admin)

request.description: Calls the database function the backend uses to authorize writes. Returns `true` for an admin token. A `false` here means every write endpoint will answer **403 forbidden**.

item.name: 1. Pages
item.description: Read the page list / one page with its ordered blocks (public, no token), and publish / unpublish pages (admin).

query.description: Optional. en | ar. With it, componentCount counts only that language's blocks.
Optional. draft | published — filter by page status.

request.description:
All CMS pages ordered by slug, with how many components each holds.

Anonymous callers only see **published** pages (RLS). Send an admin bearer to also see drafts and draft languages.

response.name: 200 OK

query.description: Required. Page slug, e.g. home, about-us, allowed-baggage.
Optional. en | ar. Returns only that language's blocks, and narrows each block's content/style to { [lang]: {...} }.

request.description:
One page with its blocks sorted by position. This is what the public website calls for every CMS-driven route.

`sectionId` = the component type (decides which React block renders it); `content` / `style` are per-language maps.

response.name: 200 OK

item.name: Get page by slug (all languages, admin view)

query.description: Required. Page slug.

request.description: Without `lang` every language's blocks are returned with the full `{ en, ar }` maps (legacy/editor view). With the admin bearer, languages kept as draft (`[[draft:ar]]`) are included as well.

Switch the whole page (every language) between `draft` and `published`. Identify the page by `slug` **or** `id`. Admin only.

If nothing changes, `meta.changed` is `false`.

With `lang`, only that language is hidden (`draft`) or shown again (`published`) via the `[[draft:…]]` marker in the page description. The public site gets 404 for a draft language. POST and PATCH behave the same.

item.name: 2. Page components (blocks)
item.description:
Add, edit, reorder and remove blocks on a page. Admin only.

⚠️ These write to the LIVE database. The default `slug` variable is `test-page` — keep it there while experimenting.

request.description:
Creates a new component of `type` and links it to page `slug` in language `lang` (default `en`).

`position` is optional — omitted = appended after the last block of that language. Returns the new block (201) — the test script saves its `uid`.
Updates one block. Each language object you send **replaces** that language's stored object (send the full object, not one field); languages you don't send are kept. `style` merges the same way.
Style is per-language: `{ en: {...}, ar: {...} }`. A flat object (no language keys) is applied to **both** languages.
Sets the block's position within its language on that page (lower = higher on the page). Other blocks are not renumbered — to reorder, send the new position of every moved block.
Unlinks the block from the page in `lang`. Without `lang` it is removed from **every** language of the page. The component row itself is kept (not hard-deleted).

query.description: Required.
Required. (componentId is accepted as an alias.)
Optional. Omit to unlink from every language.

request.description: Same as the POST variant, with query parameters.

item.name: 3. Site header
item.description:
The site header is ONE JSON document per language (table `site_header`). Read is public; save is admin-only with optimistic locking (`version`).

Workflow: run **Get header** (saves `headerVersion` and `headerDocument`), edit, then **Update header** sends them back. If someone saved in between you get **409 version_conflict** — reload and retry.

⚠️ Update changes the LIVE website header.

query.description: Optional. en (default) | ar. Anything else → 400 invalid_lang.

request.description:
Returns `{ data: { lang, document, version, updatedAt }, meta }`. 404 when no header was ever saved for that language (the website then uses its built-in default).

Cached by browsers/CDN for 60 s (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=300`).

Saves the whole header document for one language. Body: `lang` (required), `version` (the version you loaded; `null` only when the header was never saved), `document` (full document).

The document is validated; problems come back as **400 invalid_document** with `issues: [{ path, message }]`. Success returns the saved row with `version + 1`. PUT and POST behave the same.

item.name: 4. Site footer
item.description:
The site footer is ONE JSON document per language (table `site_footer`). Read is public; save is admin-only with optimistic locking (`version`).

Workflow: run **Get footer** (saves `footerVersion` and `footerDocument`), edit, then **Update footer** sends them back. If someone saved in between you get **409 version_conflict** — reload and retry.

⚠️ Update changes the LIVE website footer.

query.description: Optional. en (default) | ar. Anything else → 400 invalid_lang.

request.description:
Returns `{ data: { lang, document, version, updatedAt }, meta }`. 404 when no footer was ever saved for that language (the website then uses its built-in default).

Never cached (`no-store`).

Saves the whole footer document for one language. Body: `lang` (required), `version` (the version you loaded; `null` only when the footer was never saved), `document` (full document).

The document is validated; problems come back as **400 invalid_document** with `issues: [{ path, message }]`. Success returns the saved row with `version + 1`. PUT and POST behave the same.

item.name: 5. Offers
item.description:
Promotional offers (table `offers`). 5 types: destination, trip (one_way / round_trip / multi_city), baggage, seat, payment. Each offer ends by date (`expiry.type = time`) or by passenger count (`passengers`).

Reads: anonymous callers get only live offers (`state = active`); an admin bearer sees all. Writes: admin only.

Offer `code` must be unique — change it before re-running a create request.

query.description: Optional. destination | trip | baggage | seat | payment
Optional. draft | active | inactive
Optional. Matches code, title.en, title.ar (contains, case-insensitive).

request.description: Newest first. With the admin bearer you get every offer; without it, only offers whose computed `state` is `active`.
One offer by its UUID. 400 `invalid_id` when the id is not a UUID, 404 when it doesn't exist (or isn't visible to you).
`details`: `origin` (IATA, optional), `destination` (IATA, required, ≠ origin), `cabinClass` (any | economy | business).
`tripType` one_way / round_trip → exactly 1 segment.
Fixed discount needs a 3-letter `currency`.
`multi_city` → 2–6 segments.

`details`: `baggageType` (checked | cabin | sports_equipment), `weightKg` (1–100, whole number).

This one expires after 500 passengers instead of a date.
`details`: `seatType` (standard | extra_legroom | exit_row | front_row | preferred), `cabinClass`.
`details`: `paymentMethod` (credit_card | debit_card | bank_transfer | mobile_wallet | cash), `cardScheme` (any | visa | mastercard | amex — cards only), `minSpend` (optional number).
PUT replaces every editable field — send the whole offer (same shape and rules as create).
`status`: draft | active | inactive. Activating an offer whose end date / passenger limit is already reached → **409 offer_expired**.
Permanently deletes the offer. Returns `{ data: { id } }`.

item.name: 6. POS list (points of sale)
item.description:
Points of sale (table `pos_list`): country, flag, currency and site languages. Drives the website's POS URL segment (`/<pos>/<lang>/…`), the header POS / currency switcher and the From / To of the Excess Baggage Calculator.

Reads: anonymous callers get **active** rows only (response cached 60 s); an admin bearer gets every row plus `id`, `isActive`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`. Writes are admin-only. `posId` is saved by *Create POS* only, so Update / Delete never touch a real row by accident.

request.description: Active POS only, ordered by `position` then `code`. Shape: `{ code, nameEn, nameAr, flagUrl, currency, languages, position }`. Cached `public, max-age=60, stale-while-revalidate=300`.
Same endpoint with the admin bearer: every row (inactive too) plus `id`, `isActive`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`. Not cached. An expired token returns `401` — run *Refresh token*.

`code`: 2 lower-case letters, unique (`409 duplicate_code`). `nameEn` required; `nameAr` defaults to `nameEn`. `currency`: 3-letter ISO (upper-cased). `languages`: subset of `en`, `ar` (default both). `position`: number (default 0). `isActive`: default `true` — the example creates it inactive so it stays off the website. `airports`: `[{ code, nameEn, nameAr? }]` (3-letter codes, first = main airport; each airport belongs to one POS only → `409 duplicate_airport`). Saves `posId`.

Full replace by `id` (in the body). Send **every** field — same rules as create, `code` included; omitted fields fall back to their defaults (`isActive` → true, `languages` → en+ar, `position` → 0). `airports` is the exception: left out = unchanged.

query.description: POS row id (uuid)

request.description: Deletes the row. Returns `{ data: { id } }`. `404 not_found` for an unknown id.

item.name: 7. Baggage prices (excess baggage)
item.description:
USD price for **1 kg** of excess baggage per directed airport segment (table `baggage_segment_prices`, e.g. DAM → DXB), set in the admin's *Offers & Baggage Calculator*. The website's Excess Baggage Calculator calls *Quote* with the two POS countries and the kg.

Reads are public. *Set segment price* is admin-only and writes the LIVE price — the website uses it immediately.

request.description: Every priced segment, ordered by origin then destination: `[{ key: "DAM-KWI", origin, destination, pricePerKgUsd, updatedAt }]`. Segments without a row have no price yet.

Create or replace one directed segment's price (upsert on origin + destination). `origin` / `destination`: 3-letter IATA codes, must differ. `pricePerKgUsd`: 0–100000, at most 2 decimals. Returns the saved price. ⚠ Live data.

query.description: POS code (sy, ae, kw, iq, om, tr, ly, am) or IATA airport code
POS code or IATA airport code
Excess kg, > 0 and ≤ 1000

request.description: What the website calls. Each POS code expands to its `airports` from the POS list (main airport first, e.g. `ae` → DXB, SHJ, AUH); the first priced origin × destination pair wins. Returns `{ from, to, origin, destination, weightKg, pricePerKgUsd, totalUsd, currency: "USD" }`. `404 not_priced` when no segment between them has a price.

query.description: IATA airport code (or POS code)
IATA airport code (or POS code)
Excess kg, > 0 and ≤ 1000

request.description: What the website calculator sends: exact airports (its From / To list every POS airport) — only that one segment is checked.

item.name: 8. Destination categories
item.description:
Shared categories (table `destination_categories`) used by the **Sights Grid** filter pills and the **Destination Things to Do** badges — managed in admin **/cms2/categories**. `icon` is a Phosphor icon name (e.g. `MapPin`) or one of the original curated keys (`landmarks`, `mountains`, `museums`, …).

Reads are public; writes are admin-only. `categoryId` is saved by *Create category* only.

request.description: Ordered by `position` then `slug`: `[{ id, slug, labelEn, labelAr, icon, position, updatedAt }]`.

`slug`: 2–40 chars, lower-case letters / digits / single hyphens, unique (`409 duplicate_slug`). `labelEn`, `labelAr`: 1–80 chars. `icon`: Phosphor name or curated key (default `landmarks`). `position`: integer 0–999. Validation errors → `400 invalid_category` with `issues[]`. Saves `categoryId`.
Full replace — same body and rules as create. `400 invalid_id` if the id is not a uuid, `404 not_found` if unknown.
Deletes the category. Returns `{ data: { id } }`. Blocks that referenced it simply stop showing that badge / pill.
